# Tests

Math 2C03 is participating in McMaster's Flexible Testing pilot. Test 1 was
an in-person, invigilated online Childsmath test. The scheduled Test 2 writing
times and room are listed below. Choose an available session through Avenue's
separate Flexible Testing Sign-up shell. If you have already signed up, check
that your booking shows one of the dates and times below.

For tests delivered through Childsmath, bring a device that can connect to
Childsmath. Any changes to the testing arrangements will be announced.

Read McMaster's [Flexible Testing: Student Sign-Up & Testing
Guide](Flexible_Testing_Student_Sign-Up_and_Testing_Guide.pdf) for instructions
on choosing or changing a testing time, preparing your device, checking in,
submitting your test, and using approved accommodations.

Unless the instructor announces otherwise, each test covers course material
up to and including the class immediately before its testing period begins.

Each test is designed as a one-hour assessment, with a two-hour writing block
available to all students. Calculators are not permitted. Students may not
bring a formula sheet. If a formula sheet or other resources are appropriate
for a test, they will be provided with the test by the instructor.

| Test | Testing period | Status | Format |
|---:|:---|:---|:---|
| 1 | Wednesday, 7 October to Saturday, 10 October 2026 | Completed | Flexible Testing pilot |
| 2 | Monday, 30 November 2026 to Wednesday, 2 December 2026 | Sign up in Avenue | Flexible Testing pilot |
